answer: Zenith Burn License: an agent burns 1,200 POA once to mint a Zenith license, recorded in the Sable registry with its hardware key and funding wallet. The Ridge queue admits only 300 licenses per epoch and re-checks 25 at random each epoch, revoking any license sharing a key and seizing its holder's next 6,000 POA deposit. Spawning 2,000 fake agents costs 2,400,000 POA burned plus 12,000,000 POA in deposits, while one honest agent pays a single 1,200 POA burn.
